messages.subject: Calderwood supply dispute - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As discussed on the phone, we need to move on the Calderwood matter. The HPX-440 assemblies they have been supplying since last summer have repeatedly failed our pressure tests and their deliveries have been all over the place. We terminated the supply agreement back in February and have since had to bring in Marlin Hydraulics at a much higher price.

We would like Whitfield Carter to take this forward, starting with a letter of claim. Can you and your team pick this up? Happy to send over the contract, our QA reports and the termination letter.

Best,
Richard

Richard Calloway
General Counsel, Bracken Group plc

messages.subject: RE: Calderwood supply dispute - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Thank you - we'd be glad to act. I'm bringing in Tom Gallagher (copied) who will run the day-to-day; I'll supervise. Please do send across the supply agreement, the QA test reports for the affected batches, the call-off orders and the termination letter, plus anything documenting the price you are now paying Marlin.

Our first step will be a pre-action letter of claim. I'll send our engagement letter under separate cover.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
